notFound.title: Email not found
notFound.description: It does not exist, or it belongs to an edition you do not administer.

audience.intro: Tick the people to write to. Criteria add up, and an address selected twice receives a single message. The exact count shows in the Check step.

kindHint.submitters: The person who submitted each proposal, and the contact person when different.
kindHint.speakers: Speakers of the proposals who have an address.
kindHint.roles: People with a role on this edition: administration, committee, programming.

filterDefault.registrants: Nothing ticked: registered, waitlisted and attended.
filterDefault.roles: Nothing ticked: every role of the edition.

audience.sessionHint: To write only to the people of one published activity.
audience.extraHint: One per line, or separated by commas. They add to the criteria.

message.subject: Subject
message.variablesHint: Click to copy, then paste into the subject or the message: each recipient will read their own value.
message.bodyHint: The message is sent as shown here, with no signature added: sign it.

replies.title: Replies
replies.intro: Each recipient receives their own message. If they reply to all, the reply also reaches the copied addresses: this is how the team sees replies, since the platform's outbox cannot be read. In return, each copied address receives a copy of every message.
replies.ccHint: Suggested: your address, and the team's if one is set. Separate with commas.
replies.replyToHint: Where replies go. Empty: to the outbox, which cannot be read.
replies.bccHint: Receives every message without being shown to recipients.

review.count: No reachable recipient | This email will go to {count} person | This email will go to {count} people
review.messages: No messages | That is {count} message handed to the mail server, copies included. | That is {count} messages handed to the mail server, copies included.
review.none: Nobody would receive this email: add a criterion or an address.
review.suppressed: No excluded address | {count} address is on the suppression list (bounce or unsubscribe): it will receive nothing. | {count} addresses are on the suppression list (bounce or unsubscribe): they will receive nothing.
review.noFirstName: No recipient without a first name | {count} recipient has no known first name: the first name variable will be empty. | {count} recipients have no known first name: the first name variable will be empty.
review.copies: {addresses} will receive a copy of each of the {count} messages. To be told of replies only, the reply-to address is enough: the history already keeps what was sent.
review.testHint: To your address only, no copies, subject prefixed with “[Essai]” (French for test).
review.testSent: Test sent to {to}. It usually arrives within a minute.
review.recipientsHint: As it would be sent now. It is frozen when you send.

send.summary: Nobody will receive this email | Ready to go to {count} person | Ready to go to {count} people
send.subject: Subject: {subject}
send.explain: The list is frozen when you send. Messages leave in batches, with no sending limit; you follow their status in the history, and can stop the sending midway.
send.action: Send | Send to {count} person | Send to {count} people

confirm.title: Send this email?
confirm.description: Nobody will receive it. | It will go to {count} person. A sent email cannot be taken back. | It will go to {count} people. A sent email cannot be taken back.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this draft?
deleteConfirm.description: It has not been sent; it disappears from the history.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.usage: {used} of {max} in total. Each recipient receives every file.
attachments.usageNoMax: {used} in total. Each recipient receives every file.
attachments.typeRejected: This file type cannot be attached: PDF, office documents, text or images.
attachments.tooHeavy: With this file, attachments would exceed {max} in total. Remove one, or use a lighter file.
